title: Practice Round: The Stolen Cake Topper
tagline: A five-minute warm-up. Nobody died. The cake did not survive emotionally.

victim.name: The Cake Topper
victim.about: A tiny porcelain couple that sat on top of the anniversary cake. Now missing.

intro: PRACTICE GAME — this is not the real mystery. Use it to make sure everyone can join, read their card, see evidence unlock, and send an accusation. Someone took the porcelain cake topper off the anniversary cake between 7:00 and 7:10. Find out who.
howToPlay: This is a test run — keep it quick.
Read your card, then tap Evidence when the host releases a round.
When accusations open, pick a suspect and send it. You can only send once.
The host reveals the answer when everyone has voted.

rounds.title: Round 1 · The empty cake
rounds.prompt: Who was near the cake between 7:00 and 7:10?

exhibits.title: Cake photo
exhibits.body: The topper is gone. Two tiny footprints in the frosting.

exhibits.title: Gray's video
exhibits.body: Topper visible at 7:03. Camera off 7:04. Topper missing at 7:05.

exhibits.title: Frosting
exhibits.body: A smudge of frosting is found on a jacket belonging to one of the quiet couple.

solution.summary: Jasmine took the topper for their figurine collection.
solution.method: Grabbed it at 7:04 while Gray's camera was off.
timeline: 7:04 — camera off; Jasmine at the cake
proof: Jasmine was at the cake at 7:04 (own card)
redHerrings: Ellis was near the cake but only had crackers.
solution.reveal: It was Jasmine, in the kitchen... no, at the cake, with their pocket. Practice over — the real mystery is a lot harder!
